title: LitMundi AI-First Literary Publication Rubric
attribution: LitMundi project rubric informed by MQM terminology; AI scores are evaluative judgments, not official MQM scores, human reviews or calibrated measurements.

criteria.title: Semantic fidelity and completeness
criteria.description: Represent all propositions and purposeful ambiguity in the exact source edition. No invented, omitted, inverted or flattened meaning.

criteria.title: Voice, rhythm and register
criteria.description: Preserve the author's tone, cadence, rhetorical repetition, sentence structure where meaningful, and historical/literary register.

criteria.title: Literary naturalness in the target language
criteria.description: Idiomatic, legible literary prose rather than mechanical calques. Evaluate aloud and without viewing the source.

criteria.title: Imagery, terminology and consistency
criteria.description: Retain metaphors, symbolic contrasts, names, recurring formulas, intentional capitalization and culturally situated images.

criteria.title: Grammar, orthography and typographic care
criteria.description: Correct target-language grammar, accents, punctuation, coherent typography and stable formatting.

anchors.label: Eligible for AI-reviewed release
anchors.description: Meets the project numerical threshold; requires complete current evidence, lawful reuse and no unresolved major/critical findings. Reader feedback may reveal further defects.

anchors.label: Draft below release threshold
anchors.description: Further substantive revision and honest reassessment are needed. Do not round a below-threshold score up to 8.6.

anchors.label: Needs substantive revision
anchors.description: Material accuracy, voice or target-language weaknesses remain.

anchors.label: Not acceptable for publication
anchors.description: Significant inadequacy, incompleteness or misleading rendering.

issue_severity.minor: Limited local harm to accuracy, style, fluency or consistency.
issue_severity.major: Material distortion, omission, misleading literary image, repeated unnatural phrasing or loss of a key formal effect.
issue_severity.critical: Unusable/incomplete work, fabricated content, unlicensed material, falsified review, or pervasive meaning change.

reviewer_instructions: Assess every canonical passage against the exact original source. Identify material errors and reasonable alternatives before assigning the five scores. Disclose AI model, method and limitations. Use half-point category judgments and the original weights; the weighted score must be >=8.6 without upward threshold rounding. Bind the review to the final source/target hashes. Do not increase scores to obtain publication. A current unresolved major or critical finding blocks release. Human review is optional after publication; never label an AI assessment as a human endorsement.
